title: Clause count for gate Tseitin encoding
statement: For every vertex index $z\in\mathbb{N}$ and every finite list of Boolean circuit gates, the Tseitin CNF formed by encoding the gates successively, starting at index $z$, contains at most four clauses per gate.
hypotheses_covered: A finite list of Boolean circuit gates
